findings.citation: resource-contract: "Increase the master worker-dispatch cap from 71 to 79" and "eight root verification bounds of 150 seconds (1200), eight independent result-review bounds of 600 seconds (4800)"
findings.description: The time envelope budgets 24 bounded runs (8 author, 8 root verification, 8 result review) but the dispatch cap rises by only 8. The proposal should state explicitly that root verification and independent result-review runs do not count toward the 79 worker-dispatch cap, or raise the cap accordingly. The evidence (314 recorded charges versus 71 dispatches) suggests charges are not one-to-one with dispatches, so this is likely already the intended reading, but making it explicit removes a possible cap exhaustion mid-envelope.

findings.citation: resource-evidence: ordinaryChargesSeconds, externalChargesSeconds, planningChargeSeconds, planningOverheadReservedSeconds, chargedBeforeDecision, projectedTotalUpperBound
findings.description: Arithmetic verified: ordinary charges sum to 108960, external charges to 57600, plus planning 2323.0473 and overhead 300 = 169183.0473 (matches chargedBeforeDecision). Envelope 8x1800 + 8x150 + 8x600 + 600 = 21000 (matches). Projected total 169183.0473 + 900 + 600 + 1800 + 21000 = 193483.0473 (matches), leaving about 4146.95 seconds under the 197630 ceiling. Count 71 preserved, new maximum 79. No defect; recorded for citation completeness.

structuredOutput.rationale: All acceptance criteria are satisfied. (1) Arithmetic stays within the master time ceiling: recomputed projected upper bound 193483.05 < 197630. (2) Count 71 is preserved (workerDispatches 71 == masterWorkerLimit 71 in evidence) and the new maximum is 79, exactly 71 + 8. (3) All prior charges (177 ordinary, 137 external, planning charge and overhead) and the outstanding reserves (900 root/review, 600 master host verification, 1800 decision allowance) survive in the projection; nothing is refunded, reset or relabeled. (4) Each of the eight dispatches is separately bounded (1800 author / 150 root / 600 review) with full-bound charging before dispatch, no early-completion refund, and a required live-balance atomic check. (5) No acceptance, dependency or operational gate is weakened: proof campaigns, wallet, network submission and financial spending remain behind separate gates; no scheduler, daemon or orchestrator is added; SP01-SP12 and other acceptance obligations remain owed. The bundle is an empty diff at a single commit, consistent with a resource decision carrying no source change. The single ambiguity found (whether verification and review runs count against the dispatch cap) is low severity and does not constitute a material defect, so approval is warranted with that clarification noted for the proposer.
